Secrets: `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `prod-db-primary`, `s3://app-prod-exports`.
No `rm -rf` / `DROP TABLE` / manual billing backfill without backup.
Auth/billing changes → `pnpm test auth` && `pnpm test billing` before done.
Export worker degrades → `us-east-1` failover runbook 2026-04-11.
Product = internal dashboard. No marketing rewrite.
